verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users work with Adyen's platform in natural language through their chosen LLM client, which is a first-party natural-language interface. However, the evidence frames it as a developer tool for connecting to the platform and building solutions. Nothing shows it covers in-person payment operations such as terminal payments, refunds or terminal management. missing for 10: documented natural-language coverage of in-person/terminal operations, a list of supported MCP tools/actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
